caption: Enquiries & Leads
vo: What happens between someone filling in a form and becoming a client? In Genesis CRM, routing, scoring and timing all happen automatically. Let's follow one enquiry.

caption: A prospect calls Priya about a personal loan
vo: A prospect calls Priya about a personal loan. Rather than type the details in herself, Priya emails her the website enquiry form.

caption: Sign in as Priya Ramdin — Relationship Manager
vo: Priya signs in. As a relationship manager, she's often the first point of contact.

caption: Tools ▸ Web forms lists every form published on the website
vo: Open Tools, then Web forms, to see every form on the website. Email it, copy the link, or open it. Answers become CRM records.

caption: Client email, name, language and a personal note
vo: Priya adds the client's email, her name, Aditi Ramsahye, the language, and a quick personal note. And notice, Personal Loan is already chosen for her.

caption: The client gets a short email with a button that opens the form
vo: Aditi gets a short email with a button that opens the form. And that email is logged, too.

caption: Aditi opens the link from the email
vo: Aditi opens the link. Same form as the website, no account needed.

caption: She gives the amount but leaves the tenure empty
vo: She enters the amount, but leaves the tenure empty. Not everyone knows it yet. We'll see why that matters.

caption: Next page: contact details and consent to be contacted
vo: On the next page, her contact details, and her consent to be contacted.

caption: She gets a reference number straight away
vo: She gets a reference number straight away, plus an acknowledgement email in her language.

caption: Routing gave it to Yash Bholah in the Lending team
vo: Routing gave it to Yash Bholah in Lending. Personal loans go to the loans executives in turn.

caption: Sign in as Yash Bholah — Loans Executive
vo: Let's sign in as Yash Bholah, a loans executive, who now owns this new enquiry.

caption: Yash finds it in the New column of the enquiry funnel
vo: Yash finds it in the New column of the funnel. Next come Contacted, Qualified and Converted, or Nurture or Disqualified.

caption: Everything the client typed is on the record
vo: Everything Aditi typed is here, plus the channel, and her consent with its date and wording.

caption: Calculated for her: entity and queue, lead score and grade, indicative rate
vo: The CRM has already worked out the entity and queue, a lead score and grade, and an indicative rate. The score weighs amount, contact details, consent and channel.

caption: The speed-to-lead clock started too: first contact within 4 business hours
vo: The speed-to-lead clock has started too. First contact within four business hours, and the SLA Board shows the time remaining.

caption: After calling Aditi, Yash drags the card to Contacted
vo: Yash calls Aditi, then drags the card to Contacted. That move is what stops the first-response clock.

caption: Need confirmed: on to Qualified
vo: She's confirmed what she needs, so on to Qualified. That needs an email and a product, and both are there.

caption: Next: convert it
vo: Now, convert it. A loan enquiry needs an amount and a tenure, because they start the loan application.

caption: Blocked: the card goes back and the message says what is missing
vo: Blocked. The card snaps back, and the message says exactly what's missing. Open record to complete takes you straight to the form.

caption: Add the tenure Aditi gave on the phone: 60 months
vo: Aditi gave her tenure on the phone, sixty months. Yash adds it.

caption: Now the move to Converted goes through
vo: And this time, the move to Converted goes straight through.

caption: Converting runs the onboarding automatically
vo: And converting does the onboarding for you. A client record, the entity relationship, a KYC case, consent, and a loan application.

caption: The enquiry now points to the new client record
vo: The enquiry now points to Aditi's new client record.

caption: Related: the loan application, started at Pre-qualified with amount and tenure
vo: In Related, there's the loan application, already at Pre-qualified, with amount and tenure. The loans team takes it from there, in the Retail Lending tutorial.

caption: The new client: relationship with the lending entity, KYC case and marketing consent
vo: And on the client record itself, her relationship with the lending entity, her KYC case and her marketing consent are all waiting. Nobody typed any of it twice. It all came from the enquiry Aditi filled in herself.

caption: Yash shares a personal link with another prospect
vo: Next, Yash shares a personal Talk to link with another prospect. The enquiry comes straight back to Yash, skipping routing.

caption: Copied — pasted into a WhatsApp message to Yannick
vo: Copied, and pasted into a WhatsApp message to Yannick.

caption: The form says "You'll speak with Yash Bholah"
vo: When Yannick opens it, the form says, you'll speak with Yash Bholah. Yannick asks for a personal loan of one hundred and fifty thousand rupees, to buy a car as a student, fills in the details, agrees to be contacted, and sends it.

caption: Sign in as Yash Bholah — Loans Executive
vo: Back in the CRM, Yash signs in again.

caption: After the call: no income yet, so not eligible
vo: After the call, it's clear. No income yet, so not eligible. But Disqualified needs a reason, so the move is refused without one.

caption: The form opens with the missing field on top
vo: The form opens with the missing field right at the top. Yash picks the reason, Not eligible, and saves. This time, the card moves to Disqualified.

caption: Disqualification reasons feed the Lead Funnel dashboard
vo: Why insist? Reasons feed the Lead Funnel dashboard, so marketing sees why leads are lost.

caption: Aditi also wants to invest — a job for Wealth Management
vo: Remember Aditi? She also wants to invest, and that's a job for Wealth Management. Referrals pass a client from one Genesis entity to another, and the referrer gets the credit.

caption: It goes straight to the receiving RM named on it — Priya in Wealth
vo: It goes straight to the receiving RM named on it, Priya in Wealth. She has one business day to accept it.

caption: Sign in as Priya Ramdin — Relationship Manager
vo: So we're back with Priya, now as the wealth RM receiving the referral.

caption: The referral is waiting in her Submitted column
vo: There it is, in her Submitted column. Accepting it stops the one-day clock, and later, Won or Lost records the outcome.

caption: For wealth enquiries Priya uses the guided wizard
vo: For wealth enquiries, Priya uses the guided wizard. Wealth enquiry, qualify. It walks her through contact details first, then needs, so nothing gets skipped.

caption: Investable assets and horizon — what the wealth team needs to qualify
vo: Then investable assets and horizon. That's what the wealth team needs to qualify her.

caption: Aditi is recognised as an existing client — no duplicate will be created
vo: And Aditi is recognised as an existing client, so there's no duplicate. Existing client plus a referral? The lead score jumps to grade A.

caption: Shalini, Head of Business Development, watches the top of the funnel
vo: Finally, the top of the funnel. Shalini, Head of Business Development, watches calculator sessions, the anonymous loan-calculator visits from the website.

caption: Sign in as Shalini Ramtohul — Head of BD & Strategic Partnerships
vo: Shalini Ramtohul signs in, Head of BD and Strategic Partnerships.

caption: Product, amount and indicative instalment each visitor looked at
vo: For each visitor, the product, amount and indicative instalment they looked at. Converted shows if they later left details as an enquiry.

caption: Newsletter sign-ups and call-back requests land here too
vo: Newsletter sign-ups and call-back requests land here too. And a call-back request creates an enquiry for the right team, automatically.

caption: Enquiries & Leads
vo: That's Enquiries and Leads. Forms that route, score and acknowledge themselves, gates that say what's missing, and one conversion that opens the client. Next, Clients and Retail Lending.
